profile.headline: Software Engineer III, 8am
profile.summary:
Backend Engineer with 8 years of experience building scalable, event-driven microservices in fintech. Experienced with Scala, Java, Kafka, AWS, Elasticsearch, and distributed systems.

I enjoy solving complex backend problems, improving system performance and reliability, and designing scalable services. Always learning, building, and looking for opportunities to solve challenging engineering problems.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
Research on Smart Education and Learning Analytics.
Develop a prototype on Learning Analytics tool, where a students performance is considered in terms of his grades, and quizzes, homework etc and analyses and predicts his performance and flags red if his/her performance is critical, flags yellow if he is average, and flags green if performing excellent.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
•	Fixed defects on Property related domains in Java and Oracle 11g mainly targeting payment methods, payment coverage declaration, agent history and remittance issues and Coverage Calculation based on the policy’s information provided by the agent.
•	Focused mostly on debugging the code and fixing the defects.
•	Provided fixes in compliance with PMD and SOX and updated existing applications. Worked on Business Objects
•	Documented changes and provided fixes and developed change request projects, Also acquired knowledge on Insurance Domain.
•	Developed a pre-fill tool in javax and .js to fill details in the software for developers who perform unit testing, which saved a lot of time. Mentored junior members of the team into the business and technical domain and gave Knowledge training on a weekly basis. Organized team activities to make team members feel it’s a great place to work.
•	Updated business layer and Presentation layer of the application. Followed Agile Methodology - SCRUM
•	Was Awarded the Star of the month for excellence in Exemplary and Organizational behavior for closing the highest number of tickets consistently and for developing the Prefix tool which helped in reducing the inventory.

honors.title: Spotted
honors.description: For consistently closing the highest number of tickets.

projects.title: DATABASE DESIGN – BORING LOGS – DATABASE ON ERD
projects.description:
•	Designed a Database using ER- studio and PHP for the Civil Department to maintain records of Boring Logs used in different locations across the country and filtered by Projects and Routes.
•	Developed a logical and physical module using ER-studio and created a data dictionary.
•	Hands on Data Warehousing

projects.title: BIOMETRIC AUTHENTICATION SYSTEM USING HAND VEIN
projects.description:
•	Used to read the back-palm hand vein as password to login to accounts – substitute for finger print scanning as this project eradicates surface touching and hacking using Java, .jsp, MySQL etc.
•	It prevents hacking as the veins are an external part of the body, Analyzed and implemented the project based on Gaussian Algorithm as the skeleton of the Project.
•	Used Infra-Red rays in the form of a hand web cam to capture the hand vein patterns and then implement the algorithm to provide authentication.
